About BRACKET

BRACKET is a student-focused site that brings together past projects, lecture notes, and curated study resources. Its goal is to make learning materials easier to find, reuse, and build on.

Maintainer

Darian Vergotine — founder, curator, and maintainer

Mission

  • Make learning resources easier to discover and reuse
  • Encourage contribution and collaboration across student work
  • Share practical examples that support learning and teaching
